_comment: Clustering/dimensionality-reduction domain term/alias map for EXT-008 cross-vault candidate discovery (CAP-013). Canonical term -> aliases. Built from the actual content of batch 006 (master-ai '04 - Clustering and Dimensionality Reduction.md', 27 KUs) and batch 007 (ai-course 03.5 K-Means Clustering 1 file + 03.8 Dimensionality Reduction 2 files, 87 KUs, two deterministic single-scope runs concatenated in fixed order); every term and alias is verified to occur inside at least one in-scope KU excerpt by scripts/ext008_term_map.py (reports/extraction/ext008-term-map-verification.json). French alias 'regroupement' verified at ai-course 03.5 line 4 (parenthetical gloss of 'Clustering'); no other French vocabulary in scope (probe: nuage / données / algorithme / méthode du coude / variance expliquée / seuil / étiquette all absent). BRIDGE aliases deliberately connect different surface forms of the same concept across vaults: 'choosing k' (master-ai) with 'choose k'/'number of clusters' (ai-course); 'nonlinear' (master-ai) with 'non-linear' (ai-course); 'sklearn' (master-ai) with 'scikit-learn' (ai-course); 'inertia' (both) with 'WCSS'/'within-cluster' (ai-course). Known spurious-match source, recorded here so classification dismisses it with evidence: 'scale' word-boundary matching also hits 'large-scale' (ai-course). Note: 'silhouette' occurs ONLY on the master-ai side in this scope — the ai-course clustering-METRICS file (batch 005, extracted in EXT-005) covers silhouette from the metrics angle and is NOT part of this domain's batches; cross-domain connections wait for synthesis. Keys starting with _ are documentation and ignored by the loader.
